title: Derived left extension from coefficient levels
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B_1\leftarrow B_2\leftarrow\cdots$ an inverse sequence of sheaves of commutative rings. Let $\mathscr S(B)$ be the category of strict semilinear systems: an object consists of $B_n$-module sheaves $M_n$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $B_{n+1}$-linear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{B_{n+1}\to B_n}M_n$; morphisms commute with these maps. Restriction of scalars has the meaning of [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Use its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then $\mathscr S(B)$ is Grothendieck abelian [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Its coproducts and cohomology, and the coproducts of its unbounded derived category, are evaluated componentwise. The exact evaluations $e_n:D(\mathscr S(B))\to D(B_n)$ jointly detect isomorphisms and cohomological bounds.

For each $n\ge1$, $e_n$ has a left adjoint $L_n$, with natural evaluation formulas
$$e_mL_nP=\begin{cases}B_m\otimes^L_{B_n}P&m\le n,\\0&m>n.\end{cases}$$
Here derived change of ring has the meaning of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. More generally, let $r:\mathbf Z_{\ge1}\to\mathbf Z_{\ge1}$ be strictly increasing and unbounded, let $B_r=(B_{r(i)})_{i\ge1}$, and let $U_r:D(\mathscr S(B))\to D(\mathscr S(B_r))$ be exact restriction of systems. It has a left adjoint $L_r$. Put $t(m)=\min\{i:r(i)\ge m\}$. There is a natural formula
$$e_mL_rN=B_m\otimes^L_{B_{r(t(m))}}N_{t(m)}.$$
More precisely, put $a=t(m)$ and $b=t(m+1)$. The adjoint transition from $m+1$ to $m$ is
$$B_m\otimes^L_{B_{m+1}}e_{m+1}L_rN\cong B_m\otimes^L_{B_{r(b)}}N_b\longrightarrow B_m\otimes^L_{B_{r(a)}}N_a=e_mL_rN,$$
where the arrow is induced by the adjoint structure map $B_{r(a)}\otimes^L_{B_{r(b)}}N_b\to N_a$ of $N$. For $a=b$ this structure map is the identity; for $a<b$ it is the specified selected-level transition. All identifications use the canonical derived tensor associators. These are functors and adjunctions on the derived category of strict systems, with actual natural units and counits, not just formulas for unrelated evaluated objects. They are the total left derived functors of the strict-system left extensions along the singleton and subsequence inclusions, respectively, with the displayed evaluations. Their left-extension universal properties are the ordinary derived-category adjunctions just stated. Their adjunction identifications are compatible with composition of subsequence restrictions and the canonical tensor associators. No flatness of $B_{n+1}\to B_n$, normalization, or boundedness is assumed.

proof.text: Construct the normalized scalar assignment and its canonical tensor coherence.
Realize strict systems as modules on the ringed sequence site, giving the Grothendieck property, arbitrary small coproducts and exact evaluation.
Use exact evaluation and componentwise zero detection to obtain cohomology comparisons, joint isomorphism detection and common cohomological bounds.
Use the explicit ordinary singleton tensor-or-zero construction and its normalized derived extension, evaluation below, vanishing above, and transpose formula.
Localize the actual strict transitions and their identity equation, with the exact factorization representatives and canonical tensor unit.
Use the explicit ordinary selected left extension, derive it on simultaneous componentwise flat-term K-flat representatives, and obtain its normalized evaluation and transpose formulas.

The right evaluation cocone commutes with actual transitions. Mates and canonical scalar adjoint uniqueness prove the specified selected derived transition formula, including equal consecutive indices.

Compose exact subsequence restrictions, then take the canonical left-adjoint uniqueness map between the composite extension and the composite-index extension; its Hom equation is the composition mate.

Reindex by t_(r∘s)(m)=t_s(t_r(m)). Right evaluation squares paste, so normalized evaluation mates identify the evaluated extension compositor with the canonical scalar associator and the specified equality transport. Package all fields of the unchanged theory record.
